title.zh: Moonkov 现有 UI 清单

rows.zh: 主界面
rows.en: Main menu

rows.zh: 月面背景、角色预览、出击/仓库/光环入口、次级导航和资源显示。
rows.en: Lunar background, character preview, deployment/stash/Halo cards, secondary navigation and resources.

rows.zh: 登录与注册
rows.en: Sign-in and registration

rows.zh: 账号密码输入、登录、注册、退出账号和错误提示。
rows.en: Account and password fields, sign-in, registration, sign-out and error messages.

rows.zh: 仓库与装备
rows.en: Stash and equipment

rows.zh: 左侧角色与身体装备，中间胸挂、衣兜、工具、背包、保险箱，右侧个人仓库。
rows.en: Character and body gear on the left; carried containers and tools in the middle; personal stash on the right.

rows.zh: 物品检查与容器窗口
rows.en: Item inspection and container windows

rows.zh: 右键查看详情、拆分和操作；容器可单独打开，物品支持拖放和旋转。
rows.en: Context-menu inspection, splitting and actions; separate container windows, dragging and rotation.

rows.zh: 光环改装台
rows.en: Halo workshop

rows.zh: 光环与槽位、兼容模块列表、参数比较；安装、替换、拆卸及改装前后外观预览。
rows.en: Halo and slots, compatible module list, stat comparison, install/replace/remove and before/after visual preview.

rows.zh: 补给商目录
rows.en: Supplier directory

rows.zh: 三个补给商入口，另有应急补给和月核研究入口。
rows.en: Three supplier entries, plus emergency supplies and Mooncore research.

rows.zh: 商品购买与出售
rows.en: Shop

rows.zh: 商品列表、图标、价格、数量、物品说明，以及购买和出售。
rows.en: Product list, icons, prices, quantities, descriptions, buying and selling.

rows.zh: 应急补给
rows.en: Emergency supplies

rows.zh: 显示补给包内容和领取条件；符合条件时可领取。
rows.en: Shows bundle contents and eligibility, with a claim action when eligible.

rows.zh: 研究与制造
rows.en: Research and crafting

rows.zh: 月核与生物研究分区，材料数量与缺口，研究解锁和实体模块制造。
rows.en: Mooncore and biology branches, owned/missing materials, research unlocks and physical module crafting.

rows.zh: 任务与调查记录
rows.en: Tasks and investigation records

rows.zh: 显示三项首次带回记录、调查文字和研究入口；完整战役未接入。
rows.en: Three first-recovery records, investigation text and research access; the full campaign is not implemented.

rows.zh: 待领取物品
rows.en: Recovery inbox

rows.zh: 仓库显示未入库物品，支持单项或全部可入库领取，并提示空间不足。
rows.en: Unstored items shown from the stash, with single/all-that-fit claims and insufficient-space feedback.

rows.zh: 基地
rows.en: Base

rows.zh: 资源显示与仓库入口；建设、工坊和升级未开放。
rows.en: Resources and stash access; construction, workshops and upgrades are unavailable.

rows.zh: 通讯
rows.en: Communications

rows.zh: 联系人、频道和无消息占位；聊天与邮件未接入。
rows.en: Contacts, channels and an empty-message placeholder; chat and mail are not implemented.

rows.zh: 设置
rows.en: Settings

rows.zh: 声音、显示、语言和战斗画面设置。
rows.en: Audio, display, language and combat-display settings.

rows.zh: 出发准备 角色
rows.en: Deployment Character

rows.zh: 三角色选择、当前角色展示和已装备物品检查。
rows.en: Three character choices, current character preview and equipped-item check.

rows.zh: 出发准备 地点
rows.en: Deployment Destination

rows.zh: 地点主视觉、区域与信标信息、步骤导航。
rows.en: Destination artwork, area/beacon information and step navigation.

rows.zh: 出发准备 简报
rows.en: Deployment Briefing

rows.zh: 搜集、生存、撤离说明，以及携带电池数量调整。
rows.en: Loot, survival and extraction briefing, with carried-battery quantity controls.

rows.zh: 出发准备 回收
rows.en: Deployment Recovery

rows.zh: 死亡损失和无保障提示；保险合约入口禁用。
rows.en: Loss-on-death and uninsured notices; insurance contract action is disabled.

rows.zh: 出发准备 确认
rows.en: Deployment Confirmation

rows.zh: 角色、地点、装备和携带量汇总，最终出发按钮。
rows.en: Character, destination, equipment and carry summary, with final deployment action.

rows.zh: 玩法选择
rows.en: Mode selection

rows.zh: 远征与赏金玩法入口，支持单人或在线选择。
rows.en: Expedition and bounty entries, with solo or online selection.

rows.zh: 在线小队
rows.en: Online squad

rows.zh: 1–4 人创建/加入、队伍码、名单、准备、合作/对抗、可选匹配和出发。
rows.en: Create/join for 1–4 players, squad code, roster, ready, co-op/versus, optional matchmaking and deployment.

rows.zh: LAN 作战室
rows.en: LAN room

rows.zh: 房间浏览、创建、直连、成员名单、准备和房主出发。
rows.en: Browse/create/direct-join rooms, member list, readiness and host deployment.

rows.zh: 高级连接设置
rows.en: Advanced connection

rows.zh: 高级连接入口与 Direct/Relay 选择。
rows.en: Advanced connection access and Direct/Relay selection.

rows.zh: 创建主机弹窗
rows.en: Host creation dialog

rows.zh: 主机创建参数与确认、取消操作。
rows.en: Host creation fields with confirm and cancel.

rows.zh: 地址直连弹窗
rows.en: Direct-connect dialog

rows.zh: 地址、端口输入和连接操作。
rows.en: Address and port inputs with connection action.

rows.zh: 连接状态与加载
rows.en: Connection and loading

rows.zh: 等待、加载、错误、重试和原战局重连提示。
rows.en: Waiting, loading, errors, retry and reconnect-to-session feedback.

rows.zh: 赏金准备
rows.en: Bounty staging

rows.zh: 组队、邀请码、名单和准备；单人模式隐藏联机组队控件。
rows.en: Team setup, invite code, roster and readiness; solo hides online team controls.

rows.zh: 战斗 HUD
rows.en: Combat HUD

rows.zh: 生命、武器、弹药/充能、时间、氧气、饥渴、护盾与供能，以及战斗提示。
rows.en: Health, weapon, ammo/charge, time, oxygen, nutrition, shield/energy and combat feedback.

rows.zh: 局内背包
rows.en: In-session inventory

rows.zh: 角色装备、随身容器、保险箱、三个工具槽，底部停靠九格快捷栏。
rows.en: Gear, carried containers, secure container, three tool slots and a docked nine-slot bar.

rows.zh: 搜刮界面
rows.en: Looting

rows.zh: 自己的装备与箱子/尸体/地面包同时显示；支持搜索、拿取和拖放。
rows.en: Own inventory alongside a crate/corpse/dropped bag, with search, take and drag.

rows.zh: 健康与治疗
rows.en: Health and treatment

rows.zh: 七部位人体图、部位血量、医疗选择、治疗进度和中断提示。
rows.en: Seven-part body diagram, part health, medical choices, treatment progress and interruption feedback.

rows.zh: 快捷栏
rows.en: Quick slots

rows.zh: 1–9 九格绑定，数字键选中、左键使用；显示图标、数量和不可用状态。
rows.en: Nine bindable slots; number selects, primary click uses; icons, counts and unavailable states.

rows.zh: 局内任务提示与详情
rows.en: Objective display and details

rows.zh: 任务步骤、区域/楼层、距离、节点和设备进度；J 打开详情。
rows.en: Objective steps, area/floor, distance, device nodes and progress; J opens details.

rows.zh: 战术地图与工具读数
rows.en: Tactical map and tool readouts

rows.zh: M 打开卫星地图；位置、导航点、撤离和补给图层。另有指南针和测距仪读数。
rows.en: M opens the satellite map with position, waypoint, exits and supply layer; separate compass/rangefinder readouts.

rows.zh: 光环灯光面板
rows.en: Halo lighting panel

rows.zh: 灯光开关、参数调节和当前状态。
rows.en: Lighting toggle, parameter controls and current state.

rows.zh: 世界交互提示
rows.en: World interaction prompts

rows.zh: 拾取、搜索、气闸、灯光、开关和设备的名称、按键与操作进度。
rows.en: Names, keys and progress for pickup, search, airlocks, lights, switches and devices.

rows.zh: 撤离提示
rows.en: Extraction display

rows.zh: 撤离条件、范围内状态、倒计时，以及受阻或中断提示。
rows.en: Eligibility, in-zone state, countdown and blocked/interrupted feedback.

rows.zh: 行动结果
rows.en: Session result

rows.zh: 撤离成功、死亡或超时，以及本局结果摘要。
rows.en: Extraction, death or timeout, with the session summary.

rows.zh: 结算物资
rows.en: Cargo result

rows.zh: 结算第二页，显示本局物品与带回情况。
rows.en: Second result page, listing session items and recovered cargo.

rows.zh: 入库与返回
rows.en: Storage result

rows.zh: 结算第三页，显示保存、入库、失败重试与返回。
rows.en: Third result page: saving, storage, retry and return.

rows.zh: 暂停菜单
rows.en: Pause menu

rows.zh: 在游戏画面上显示继续、返回主界面和退出。
rows.en: Overlay on the game view with resume, main menu and exit.

rows.zh: 死亡提示
rows.en: Death display

rows.zh: 显示可取得的死亡信息，并转入结算。
rows.en: Shows available death information and proceeds to settlement.

rows.zh: 赏金战斗界面
rows.en: Bounty combat display

rows.zh: 阶段、目标、放逐、赏金归属、队友状态、暗视、救援和出口提示。
rows.en: Phase, target, banishment, bounty ownership, teammates, dark sight, revival and exit feedback.

rows.zh: 赏金结束界面
rows.en: Bounty result

rows.zh: 结果与保存状态，返回飞船或准备下一局。
rows.en: Outcome and save status, with return to ship or prepare next round.
